Earphone Jack Quirk.name: Earphone Jack Quirk
Earphone Jack Quirk.description:
🎧 You have plug-tipped earlobes that hear and carry vibrations.

🌱 At the start you extend two jacks several meters, plug into a surface to hear nearby footsteps or send a modest heartbeat vibration, and jab a close target.
📈 With training: finer searches, stronger heartbeat pulses, amplified ground shocks, amplified attacks that protect an exit.
⚠️ You need a connected surface and amplifiers for wide attacks; pulls and damaging noise hurt your jacks, and heavy output leaves your ears ringing or bleeding.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Bodily Toll, as heavy use hurts your ears.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Kyoka Jiro's Earphone Jack. You are not related to her; people who know her Quirk notice the resemblance.

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Analysis +10, Quirk Output +10, Perception +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Plugside Listen, Close Jack Jab
Earphone Jack Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: plug-tipped earlobes. Start: a jack reaches several meters into walls, floors or sockets to hear steps, voices, machines, send a modest heartbeat pulse, or jab and hook. Training, amplifier gear: finer searches, stronger beats, directed sound.
Limits: grabs, pulls, strikes or harsh noise on a jack hurt the ear. Only vibration through the connected material: no thoughts, no reach across unrelated surfaces. Wide attacks need amplifier, connected surface, clear path; no shouted blasts. Heavy output makes ears ring or bleed.
Quirk Strain: light: listen, jab; moderate: long search, trip, focused pulse; heavy: amplified ground or air pulses; severe: repeated full-output pulses.
Drawback: built in, the canon Bodily Toll.
Canon: Kyoka Jiro's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Mutant.
Law: unpermitted private-wall listening can breach privacy; user answers for harmful public sound.
Look: plugs.
